[SWS_DM_02045] Reporting clearing of dtc failed to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service ClearDiagnosticInformation is received, which results in a neg-
ative response, the DM shall report a security event SEV_UDS_CLEAR_DTC_FAILED
to IdsM (see [26] and table [SWS_DM_02046]) with the context data given in
[SWS_DM_02046].
